# Add Spacing Around The Section

## Add Spacing Around The Section

In Figma, the Professional Journey section doesn't feel glued to the hero. There's clear breathing room before the heading, and that's what we're adding here.

Also you'll make the section title feel like a real heading, and the intro line feel quieter under it.

Expected Output

![Add Spacing Around the Section](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Add a border at the top of the journey container and vertical spacing in the container.

Add layout styles like flex properties to it so it feels clearly separated from the hero section.Style the Professional Journey section heading and intro text to match the visual hierarchy from the design.

In style.css, style .journey h2Style the briefcase icon per figma.

Style the journey lists a container that sits directly under the heading. Note the flex direction to be column and gap to be 40px.
